rules.official_first: Compare each candidate to its own operator site whenever available; only mark operator-confirmed after branch-level matching.
rules.location: Official address alone does not confirm exact GPS or entrance.
rules.operation: Store locator presence alone does not prove currently open.
rules.conflict: Preserve differing observations; flag for review.
rules.fuel: Owner allows directory/community candidate publication with UNKNOWN operation and feedback, never verified OPEN solely from OSM.
rules.vinfast: No undocumented/private API scraping or inferred live charger availability.

official_sources.finding: Dynamic public locator exists; Phu Quoc station-level list not retrievable from static HTML in this audit; keep existing OSM charging points unverified.
App supports live plug availability, but public page does not provide individual station availability.

official_sources.brand: Dien May Xanh / The Gioi Di Dong
official_sources.finding: Operator lists seven Phu Quoc stores, including two Dien May Xanh branches to review for additions or duplicate conflicts.
Use operator branch pages to confirm address and branch existence; Ganh Dau temporary-closure claim from third-party directory requires operator recheck.
Corporate website is not proof of an individual Phu Quoc retail station; no current official branch-level retail list extracted in this audit.

publication: No canonical data or production view changes in this audit.
